description: §15.11.1 — a body write to a `bind` prop reaches the caller's bound cell in every write form (`count++`, `count += 10`, `count = count * 2`) and at every render position of the component (top level, inside `<each>`, inside a `lift`, inside a `<match>` arm). Each instance is bound to its own cell; 1 → 11 → 22 per instance.
rationale: §15.11.1: 'Changes to the bindable prop inside the component SHALL propagate back to `@var` in the parent.'
